office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders in King County District Court for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: sitting District Court Judge Rebecca Robertson, the court's Chief Presiding Judge, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Chief Presiding Judge of King County District Court, on the bench since 2010 (first in Federal Way Municipal Court); previously a prosecuting attorney.
highlights: Judge since 2010; appointed to District Court in 2021 and elected in 2022 [S1]
Chief Presiding Judge of King County District Court [S1]
Past President of the District and Municipal Court Judges' Association; serves on the Board for Judicial Administration [S1]
